summary: The filing reports a routine unregistered sale of limited partnership units in a continuously offered private fund. On August 1, 2026, the fund sold 1,069,268 units across four classes for about $30.4 million, with prices based on month-end transactional net asset values. Sales were exempt under Regulation D and Section 4(a)(2), limited to accredited investors and qualified purchasers. No tender offer, strategic review, or special-situation event occurred. The filing is a standard Form 8-K disclosure of an exempt private offering; the cumulative issuance of $864 million reflects ongoing operations. No special-situation angle applies; the filing is categorized as None.
